instruction: Please configure the system to automatically adjust display color temperature based on time of day.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because verifying automatic color temperature changes over time in a VM environment is not practical, and the feature may not function properly without real hardware display controls.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - automatic time-based color temperature verification is not practical in automated testing
Verification would require either waiting for actual time to pass (hours) or complex system time manipulation
Reading display color temperature settings in VM environment is not reliably possible with standard getters
Hardware display controls may not function properly in VM, making verification unreliable
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for this task
